provincial.name: Employment Support and Income Assistance (ESIA)

provincial.notes: Rates from what-you-receive.html (fetched): Standard single rent/own $738. Extra help for barrier-free access if physical disability. Pharmacare $5/Rx. Eligibility sub-page not fetched.

provincial.notes: Same program as ESIA; fold into one record.
